title: Interior Designer
description:
**Company Description**
Inside Interiors is a design-focused firm specializing in functional and aesthetically refined interior spaces for residential and commercial clients. The team collaborates closely with clients to understand their lifestyle, brand, and spatial needs, delivering tailored design solutions. Projects range from small-scale renovations to complete interior fit-outs, offering exposure to diverse styles and requirements. Joining Inside Interiors provides opportunities to contribute to creative design work, collaborate with multidisciplinary professionals, and grow in a supportive, quality-driven environment.

**Role Description**
This is a full-time Interior Designer role based in Rohtak, structured as a hybrid position with a mix of on-site work and some work-from-home flexibility. Day-to-day responsibilities include developing interior concepts, preparing mood boards, and creating space plans that meet client requirements and building standards. The Interior Designer will produce detailed construction drawings, select FF&E (furniture, fixtures, and equipment), and coordinate with vendors, contractors, and consultants to ensure accurate implementation of the design. The role involves meeting clients, gathering requirements, presenting design proposals, and revising designs based on feedback. The Interior Designer will also support project management tasks such as site visits, progress reviews, and basic budgeting and material estimation.

**Qualifications**

* Strong skills in Interior Design and Space Planning, with the ability to translate client needs into functional, visually appealing layouts.
* Knowledge of Architecture principles and building codes relevant to interior projects.
* Proficiency in preparing accurate Construction Drawings and technical documentation for contractors and vendors.
* Experience with FF&E selection, including furniture, fixtures, finishes, and equipment that align with design concepts and budgets.
* Relevant academic background such as a diploma or degree in Interior Design, Architecture, or a related field.
* Proficiency in design and drafting software (e.g., AutoCAD, SketchUp, Revit, or similar) and basic familiarity with presentation tools.
* Strong visual and conceptual skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills for working with clients, contractors, and team members.
* Prior experience in residential or commercial interior projects is preferred but not mandatory.

title: Associate Visual Designer
description:
**Associate Visual Designer**

**Company:**
Desmania

**Experience:**
2–3 years

**Team:**
Industrial Design

**About the Role**

We are looking for a Visual Designer with 2–3 years of experience to join our Industrial Design team. The role involves creating visual communication for brands, products, presentations, packaging and digital applications.

You should have a strong sense of typography, composition and colour, with the ability to develop ideas and carry them through to final artwork. You will work closely with industrial designers and project leads, taking ownership of assigned work and maintaining quality across deliverables.

**Responsibilities**

* Understand project briefs, brand requirements and target audiences before developing design concepts.
* Create layouts, presentations, brochures, packaging graphics, product graphics, infographics, emailers and digital assets.
* Develop distinct design options that offer different approaches to the brief.
* Establish and follow grids, typography styles and visual guidelines to maintain consistency across a project.
* Translate research, technical information and product features into clear visual communication.
* Work within an existing design language or develop a fresh direction with guidance from the project lead.
* Collaborate with industrial designers to integrate graphics with product form, function and manufacturing requirements.
* Present design concepts and explain the reasoning behind design decisions.
* Incorporate feedback while maintaining the intent and quality of the design.
* Prepare accurate, editable and organised files for print, digital delivery and production.
* Check final artwork for typography, alignment, colour, resolution and consistency.
* Manage assigned tasks, communicate progress and meet project deadlines.

**Skills and Qualifications**

* 2–3 years of relevant experience in graphic design, visual communication or a related field.
* A degree or diploma in Graphic Design, Communication Design, Visual Communication or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* A strong portfolio demonstrating concept development, layout skills and attention to detail.
* Proficiency in Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop.
* Working knowledge of Figma, Adobe InDesign and PowerPoint.
* Strong understanding of typography, colour theory, composition, visual hierarchy and design principles.
* Knowledge of print and digital artwork requirements, including colour modes, resolution, bleed and file formats.
* Ability to balance visual quality with functional requirements and production constraints.
* Ability to work independently on assigned tasks and collaborate with others.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills.
* Openness to feedback, willingness to learn and a responsible approach to quality and deadlines.

**Additional Skills**

* Experience in packaging, branding, product graphics or interface design.
* Illustration, icon design or basic motion graphics skills.
* Experience creating presentation narratives and infographics.

**Application Requirements**

Please share your résumé and portfolio. Include projects that show your design process, concept exploration and final execution. For team projects, clearly mention your role and contribution.
